en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European riverside town with a stone and metal bridge crossing a wide river. A long barge is on the water in the foreground, while trams, pedestrians, and streetlights line the riverbank road on the right. On the hill above the clustered old town stands a large complex with twin Gothic cathedral towers and adjoining castle‑like buildings. Handwritten text at the bottom identifies the place.
